structured_output.summary: The change implements %TypedArray%.prototype.find as the spec describes. It validates the typed array, takes its length, then runs a local FindViaPredicate that handles only the ascending direction. That helper checks the predicate is callable, then loops from 0 to length. Each step does Get, Call, then ToBoolean, and every `?` propagates. If nothing matches it returns undefined. The step order is correct: the this-value check comes before the predicate check. The 6 remaining failures in the gate report are "not implemented: BigInt", an honest not-implemented error from outside this file. I found no special-casing, swallowed errors or unrelated edits.
